findings.title: The Maryland African American Museum Corporation (MAAMC) did not always comply with its written procurement policy regarding obtaining written proposals and obtaining management approvals.
findings.description: MAAMC failed to obtain required vendor proposals for two procurements totaling $279,500 and lacked documentation for approvals on five procurements totaling $439,500 during fiscal years 2018 through 2021. The audit tested 10 procurements with payments totaling $569,700.

dollar_amounts.context: payments totaling in test of procurements
procurements for security and accounting services without two written vendor proposals
procurements with associated payments lacking required approvals

findings.recommendation: We recommend that MAAMC comply with its procurement policy. Specifically, we recommend that MAAMC a. obtain at least two written proposals for all procurements greater than $10,000 as required (repeat), and b. ensure that procurements receive the appropriate documented approvals in accordance with its policy (repeat).

findings.title: Adequate accountability and controls were not established over MAAMC’s museum collections of art and historical artifacts.
findings.description: As of March 2021, MAAMC had not assigned values to 8,900 collection items (76 percent) and failed to maintain an independent control record or perform required physical inventories on 4,375 artifacts with $1.2 million in insured value. Additionally, duties were not separated between staff maintaining records and those accessing collections.

dollar_amounts.context: artifacts not inventoried for at least three years with insured value

findings.recommendation: We recommend that MAAMC a. maintain a control record of its museum collections that is independent of its detail records (repeat); b. develop a policy to identify items in its collections with potentially significant values and ensure that values are assigned to these items in its records (repeat); c. perform independent physical inventories every three years, as required, and update the detailed records accordingly; and d. ensure that employees who maintain the detail records do not have physical access to the collections (repeat).

extraction.agency_response_summary: MAAMC agreed to all findings and recommendations in their written response. They noted that staff turnover and the COVID-19 pandemic impacted implementation but committed to corrective actions with completion dates between September 2021 and June 2022.
